scope: Distribution payload metadata and notices only; no audio, build, signing, hardware or release acceptance claim
conditions: CI tar/zip and all three native installers carry the same project and third-party notices byte-for-byte
Installer SOURCE.txt identifies a full commit from the packaging checkout, with an immutable source link and no numerical acceptance claim
Installer document manifest hashes each staged document and identifies its scope as checkout provenance, not independent binary/source equivalence
Tracked dirty checkout, mismatched GITHUB_SHA, missing required notice, linked input notice, existing output and output nested under a tracked document are rejected
Linux .deb payload is independently reopened and each expected document byte is compared
Synthetic files used by packaging tests are labelled as fixtures and never cited as successful plugin builds
